name.value: Best Western Plus Baker Street Inn & Convention Center

description.value: The Best Western Plus Baker Street Inn is the only full-service hotel on Nelson's storied Baker Street, placing cyclists at the heart of this eclectic Kootenay mountain town celebrated for its arts scene and outdoor recreation. The property includes a convention centre and offers amenities such as free breakfast and kitchenette-equipped rooms, catering to a wide range of guests. Nelson sits at the confluence of several popular cycle-touring routes through the West Kootenay region.
